title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #13

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. "Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin" means (1 mark)
   A. I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
   B. Allah is the greatest
   C. Say: He is Allah, the One
   D. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

2. Which of these is a trait of the Prophet's character? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Honesty
   C. Laziness
   D. Boasting

3. What is the best way to avoid wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Take a very large plate
   B. Refuse to eat
   C. Take only what you can finish
   D. Feed it to no one

4. What does the Qur'an (7:31) say about eating and drinking? (1 mark)
   A. Eat as much as possible
   B. Eat and drink but do not waste
   C. Eat only at night
   D. Never eat sweets

5. What is fair play? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping the rules and not cheating
   B. Insulting opponents
   C. Ignoring the referee
   D. Winning at all costs

6. Which greeting should players give at the end of a match? (1 mark)
   A. An insult
   B. Silence
   C. Salaam and a handshake
   D. A shout

7. Which attribute means Allah is free from all faults? (1 mark)
   A. As-Salam
   B. Al-Basir
   C. Ar-Rahim
   D. Al-Malik

8. Which of these is a mistake about Allah's names? (1 mark)
   A. Thinking Allah is like a human being
   B. Learning them
   C. Teaching them
   D. Using them in dua

9. Kevin returns a lost charger when nobody sees him. Which belief helped him? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   B. Nobody cares
   C. Allah is a picture
   D. Allah is far away

10. What does "Al-Malik" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Most Kind
   B. The Source of Peace
   C. The All-Seeing
   D. The King and Owner of everything

11. Malakul Maut takes souls (1 mark)
   A. Whenever he likes
   B. By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   C. Only from old people
   D. Only at night

12. Which is spiritual purity? (1 mark)
   A. Sweeping the room
   B. Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   C. Washing hands
   D. Washing clothes

13. "Taahir" means (1 mark)
   A. Pure and clean
   B. Fasting
   C. Prayer
   D. Impure

14. How is a medium najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go
   B. Wash seven times with soil
   C. Ignore it
   D. Sprinkle once

15. What is a mukhaffafah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A medium najasa
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. A light najasa
   D. A pure thing

16. Which part is washed first in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Hands
   B. Ears
   C. Feet
   D. Head

17. What is a difference between a condition and a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. They are the same
   B. A pillar is before prayer
   C. A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   D. A condition is inside prayer

18. Which of these can help find prayer times? (1 mark)
   A. Asking a stranger to guess
   B. Guessing from the weather only
   C. A mosque timetable or the adhan
   D. Counting stars only

19. What is a condition of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A type of dua
   B. A festival
   C. A part inside prayer
   D. Something needed before the prayer starts

20. What should a person do if unable to stand for obligatory prayer because of illness? (1 mark)
   A. Wait until well
   B. Pray later in the year
   C. Skip the prayer
   D. Pray sitting

21. What is "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Mercy
   C. Fear
   D. Anger

22. What does the Qur'an say about everything in the heavens and earth? (1 mark)
   A. They glorify Allah
   B. They are silent
   C. They are useless
   D. They ignore Him

23. What is a kofia? (1 mark)
   A. A coat
   B. A shoe
   C. A cap
   D. A belt

24. What is the awrah? (1 mark)
   A. A fast
   B. A prayer
   C. The parts of the body that must be covered
   D. A cap

25. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Hurting others with messages or online posts
   B. Reading news
   C. Learning
   D. Praying

26. What did the Prophet say about speech? (1 mark)
   A. Speak loudly
   B. Say whatever
   C. Say everything
   D. Say what is good or keep silent

27. What is "income"? (1 mark)
   A. Money earned from work
   B. A prayer
   C. Debt
   D. A gift

28. Which of these is honest work? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Gambling
   C. Stealing
   D. Farming

29. What do we say at the end of a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Nothing
   C. Goodbye
   D. Amin

30. Which is an obligation of parents? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring children
   B. Providing food, clothing and shelter
   C. Neglecting health
   D. Making them work all day

31. Which is a good way to say sorry to a parent? (1 mark)
   A. Say sorry politely and try to improve
   B. Blame
   C. Refuse
   D. Shout

32. Even if parents command wrong, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Leave home
   B. Insult them
   C. Ignore them
   D. Still treat them kindly in worldly matters

33. What does the hadith say about keeping family ties? (1 mark)
   A. It has no effect
   B. It reduces provision
   C. It causes trouble
   D. It increases provision and life

34. What should you do when relatives have a quarrel? (1 mark)
   A. Gossip
   B. Spread stories
   C. Take sides in anger
   D. Forgive and make peace

35. Which is a way to apply the first verses? (1 mark)
   A. Read and study daily
   B. Ignore books
   C. Avoid school
   D. Skip reading

36. Who did Khadija take the Prophet to for advice? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Abu Talib

37. Which of these was freed by Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Abu Talib
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Waraqa

38. Which quality did the early converts show? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Loyalty and courage
   C. Cowardice
   D. Greed

39. What was Khadija's job? (1 mark)
   A. Soldier
   B. Farmer
   C. Businesswoman
   D. Teacher

40. What does "convert" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A person who accepts a new faith
   B. A teacher
   C. A traveller
   D. A trader

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Name the three types of najasaat. (3 marks)

42. What does twahara mean and why is it important? (2 marks)

43. Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya. (3 marks)

44. What must a boy and what must a girl cover in prayer at the least? (3 marks)

45. Explain what a person should do if they do not like a food served to them. (3 marks)

46. Why is betting in a game not allowed? (3 marks)

47. List the first four pillars of swalah. (4 marks)

48. Explain why keeping family ties is important. (4 marks)

49. Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir. (3 marks)

50. Explain tawakkul using an example. (3 marks)

51. Choose one early convert and explain a lesson children can learn from that person. (4 marks)

52. Describe how a Grade 4 child can practise honesty, generosity, patience and obedience. (4 marks)

53. Explain how belief in Raqib and Atid helps a child behave well. (3 marks)

54. Suggest four situations in which a Grade 4 child needs patience, tolerance or perseverance. (4 marks)

55. Write the six pillars of Iman and put a mark next to the one studied in this lesson. (4 marks)

56. Describe how a class can show kindness to creatures in the school compound. (4 marks)

57. How did Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) show generosity? (3 marks)

58. List the steps of wudhu in order from the hands to the feet. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
   This is the second verse of Al-Fatiha.

2. B — Honesty
   The Prophet was known as trustworthy and truthful.

3. C — Take only what you can finish
   Small portions can be repeated if needed.

4. B — Eat and drink but do not waste
   Allah does not love those who waste.

5. A — Keeping the rules and not cheating
   Fair play means honesty in sport.

6. C — Salaam and a handshake
   Respect and greetings are Islamic manners.

7. A — As-Salam
   As-Salam means He is perfect and free of faults.

8. A — Thinking Allah is like a human being
   Nothing is like Allah.

9. A — Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   He knows Allah sees everything.

10. D — The King and Owner of everything
   Al-Malik means the true King.

11. B — By Allah's permission at the time Allah decided
   Nothing happens without Allah's decree.

12. B — Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   Repentance and good deeds purify the heart.

13. A — Pure and clean
   Taahir is the opposite of najis.

14. A — Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go
   Wash until the traces have gone.

15. C — A light najasa
   Mukhaffafah means light.

16. A — Hands
   The hands are washed first.

17. C — A condition is before the prayer, a pillar is inside it
   Conditions before, pillars inside.

18. C — A mosque timetable or the adhan
   These are reliable.

19. D — Something needed before the prayer starts
   Conditions come before the prayer begins.

20. D — Pray sitting
   Islam gives ease.

21. B — Mercy
   Rahmah means mercy.

22. A — They glorify Allah
   All creation praises Allah.

23. C — A cap
   A kofia is a cap.

24. C — The parts of the body that must be covered
   Awrah is what must be covered.

25. A — Hurting others with messages or online posts
   Bullying done online.

26. D — Say what is good or keep silent
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

27. A — Money earned from work
   Income is what we earn.

28. D — Farming
   Honest work is farming.

29. D — Amin
   Amin means "O Allah, accept".

30. B — Providing food, clothing and shelter
   Basic needs.

31. A — Say sorry politely and try to improve
   Apologise.

32. D — Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   Qur'an 31:15.

33. D — It increases provision and life
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

34. D — Forgive and make peace
   Islam teaches forgiveness.

35. A — Read and study daily
   Apply the command to read.

36. B — Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   Waraqa knew earlier scriptures.

37. A — Bilal
   Bilal was freed.

38. B — Loyalty and courage
   They stayed firm.

39. C — Businesswoman
   She was a respected trader.

40. A — A person who accepts a new faith
   A convert changes beliefs.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Twahara means purity. It is a condition for prayer and other acts of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for importance.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: A boy must cover from the navel to the knees. A girl must cover the whole body except the face and hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy, 1 mark for the girl, 1 mark for the general rule of modest clothes.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave it quietly and politely without criticising, as the Prophet did, and thank the person.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not criticising, 1 mark for quietness or politeness, 1 mark for thanks.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gambling is forbidden in Islam because it takes people's wealth unfairly and can cause harm and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forbidden, 1 mark for unfairness, 1 mark for harm.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Niyyah, qiyam, takbiratul ihram, and reciting Al-Fatiha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is Allah's command, it brings love, unity and support, brings blessing and is an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example, Ali teaches that a young person can be brave and truthful for Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person, 1 mark for a fact, 1 mark for a lesson, 1 mark for clear explanation.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: return lost items; generosity: share lunch; patience: wait calmly for a turn; obedience: come when parents call.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each virtue with a suitable action.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words and actions are recorded, so the child speaks the truth, avoids wrong and does good, and repents when wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for recorded deeds, 1 mark for good behaviour, 1 mark for repentance.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being teased, failing a test, a friend refusing to play, being sick, dealing with a rude neighbour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable situation.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day and destiny. Angels are the one studied.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for every two pillars named, 1 mark for identifying angels.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees, put out water for birds, keep the compound clean, do not harm insects and animals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: When guests came, he quickly brought a fattened calf to serve them and welcomed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for guests, 1 mark for the food, 1 mark for welcome.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to ankles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each three steps in the right order.
